# Synthetic 3D block fixture

`block3d25.bin` and `block3d25.cfb` exercise a restricted root reference to direct
3D definition lines. Tests cover source ownership, placement arithmetic,
unsupported descendants, invalid values, and output limits.

The construction is in `scripts/make_block3d_fixture.py`. The project-authored data
is implementation test input, not a claim of general 3D scene compatibility.
